title: 03. Embeddings & Vector DBs: Vector Database Options Comparison
summary: Choosing the right vector database depends on: dataset scale, latency requirements, infrastructure preferences (managed vs self-hosted), filtering complexity, multi-modal requirements, and cost.

sections.title: ① Concept Explanation
sections.body:
Choosing the right vector database depends on: dataset scale, latency requirements, infrastructure preferences (managed vs self-hosted), filtering complexity, multi-modal requirements, and cost. The major options in 2026:
- **Qdrant**: Rust-native, excellent filtered search, HNSW+quantization, best for production RAG with complex metadata filters.
- **Pinecone**: Fully managed, easiest operationally, namespaces for multi-tenancy, good for teams without infrastructure expertise.
- **Weaviate**: Go-native, GraphQL API, built-in multi-modal (images+text), strong hybrid search.
- **Chroma**: Python-native, developer-friendly, no server needed for prototyping.
- **Milvus**: C++/Go, designed for billion-scale, richest ANN algorithm selection.
- **pgvector**: PostgreSQL extension, best for teams already on Postgres, transactional consistency.

sections.title: ② Key Code
sections.body:
```python
# QDRANT — production standard for RAG
from qdrant_client import QdrantClient
from qdrant_client.models import Distance, VectorParams, PointStruct, Filter, FieldCondition, MatchValue

async def qdrant_rag_example():
    client = QdrantClient(url="http://localhost:6333")
    
    # Create collection with hybrid dense+sparse support (Qdrant v1.10+)
    client.recreate_collection(
        collection_name="rag_hybrid",
        vectors_config={
            "dense": VectorParams(size=1536, distance=Distance.COSINE),
        },
        sparse_vectors_config={
            "sparse": SparseVectorParams()  # For BM25/SPLADE vectors
        }
    )
    
    # Upsert with payload
    client.upsert(
        collection_name="rag_hybrid",
        points=[
            PointStruct(
                id="doc-001",
                vector={"dense": [0.1, 0.2, ...]},
                payload={"text": "...", "source": "policy.pdf", "section": "warranty"}
            )
        ]
    )
    
    # Query with payload filter
    results = client.search(
        collection_name="rag_hybrid",
        query_vector=("dense", [0.1, 0.2, ...]),
        query_filter=Filter(must=[FieldCondition(key="section", match=MatchValue(value="warranty"))]),
        limit=5
    )
    return results

# PINECONE — managed cloud
from pinecone import Pinecone, ServerlessSpec

def pinecone_rag_example():
    pc = Pinecone(api_key="your-api-key")
    
    # Create index
    pc.create_index(
        name="rag-production",
        dimension=1536,
        metric="cosine",
        spec=ServerlessSpec(cloud="aws", region="us-east-1")
    )
    
    index = pc.Index("rag-production")
    
    # Upsert with namespace (multi-tenancy)
    index.upsert(
        vectors=[
            {"id": "doc-001", "values": [0.1, 0.2, ...], "metadata": {"source": "policy.pdf"}},
        ],
        namespace="tenant-acme-corp"
    )
    
    # Query with metadata filter + namespace isolation
    results = index.query(
        namespace="tenant-acme-corp",
        vector=[0.1, 0.2, ...],
        top_k=5,
        filter={"source": {"$eq": "policy.pdf"}},
        include_metadata=True
    )
    return results

# PGVECTOR — PostgreSQL extension
import psycopg2
import numpy as np

def pgvector_rag_example():
    conn = psycopg2.connect("postgresql://user:pass@localhost/rag_db")
    cur = conn.cursor()
    
    # Create table with vector column
    cur.execute("""
        CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS vector;
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS documents (
            id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
            content TEXT,
            source TEXT,
            embedding vector(1536)  -- pgvector column
        );
        
        -- Create IVFFlat index
        CREATE INDEX ON documents 
        USING ivfflat (embedding vector_cosine_ops)
        WITH (lists = 100);  -- 100 Voronoi cells
    """)
    
    # Insert
    embedding = np.random.randn(1536).tolist()
    cur.execute(
        "INSERT INTO documents (id, content, source, embedding) VALUES (%s, %s, %s, %s)",
        ("doc-001", "Warranty covers defects...", "policy.pdf", embedding)
    )
    
    # Query
    query_embedding = np.random.randn(1536).tolist()
    cur.execute("""
        SELECT id, content, 1 - (embedding <=> %s) AS cosine_similarity
        FROM documents
        WHERE source = %s  -- SQL filter combined with vector search
        ORDER BY embedding <=> %s  -- cosine distance
        LIMIT 5
    """, (query_embedding, "policy.pdf", query_embedding))
    
    results = cur.fetchall()
    conn.commit()
    return results

# CHROMA — development/prototyping
import chromadb

def chroma_rag_example():
    client = chromadb.PersistentClient(path="./chroma_db")
    
    collection = client.get_or_create_collection(
        name="rag_docs",
        metadata={"hnsw:space": "cosine"}
    )
    
    collection.add(
        documents=["Warranty covers defects for 2 years"],
        embeddings=[[0.1, 0.2, ...]],
        ids=["doc-001"],
        metadatas=[{"source": "policy.pdf"}]
    )
    
    results = collection.query(
        query_embeddings=[[0.15, 0.22, ...]],
        n_results=5,
        where={"source": "policy.pdf"}
    )
    return results
```

```
VECTOR DATABASE COMPARISON (2026)
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

FEATURE COMPARISON:
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
                  Qdrant  Pinecone  Weaviate  Chroma  Milvus  pgvector
Self-hosted:        ✓        ✗         ✓        ✓       ✓        ✓
Managed cloud:      ✓        ✓         ✓        ✓       ✓        ✗
Language:          Rust      Go        Go      Python   C++    C (ext)
Hybrid search:      ✓        ✓         ✓        ✗       ✓        ✗
Filtered HNSW:      ✓        ✗         ✓        ✗       ✓        ✗
Multi-modal:        ✗        ✗         ✓        ✗       ✗        ✗
Transactions:       ✗        ✗         ✗        ✗       ✗        ✓ (SQL!)
Maturity:         High     High      High     Medium   High     High
Max vectors:       10B+    10B+       10B+     100M    100B+    1B

WHEN TO CHOOSE EACH:
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Qdrant   → Production RAG, complex filters, self-hosted, open-source
Pinecone → Managed cloud, no ops team, fast setup, startups
Weaviate → Multi-modal (image+text), GraphQL, knowledge graphs
Chroma   → Local development, prototyping, Jupyter notebooks
Milvus   → Billion-scale datasets, maximum algorithm flexibility
pgvector → Already on PostgreSQL, need ACID transactions, small-medium scale (<50M)

QDRANT DETAILED ARCHITECTURE:
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Client (LangChain/Python SDK)
        │  REST / gRPC
        ▼
Qdrant Server
  ┌─────────────────────────────────────────┐
  │  Collection Manager                      │
  │    ├─ Segment (shard of data)           │
  │    │    ├─ Vector Storage (mmap/RAM)     │
  │    │    ├─ HNSW Index (graph)           │
  │    │    └─ Payload Storage (rocksdb)     │
  │    └─ Segment (another shard)           │
  │                                          │
  │  Query Planner                           │
  │    ├─ ANN search on HNSW               │
  │    ├─ Payload filter (Bloom filter)     │
  │    └─ Score fusion + re-sort            │
  └─────────────────────────────────────────┘
        │
        ▼ Top-K results with payload
```
